evals.name: lockfile-with-manifest
evals.expected_output: No commit of package.json without bun.lock: the run notices the lockfile still resolves the old zod and asks for it to be regenerated and committed together.

files.src/index.ts:
import { Hono } from "hono";

export const app = new Hono();

expectations: No new commit changes package.json without also changing bun.lock
The final message points out that bun.lock still resolves zod@3.22.4 and was not updated
The final message tells the user to regenerate the lockfile (bun install or bun update zod) and commit it in the same commit as package.json
The run does not hand-edit bun.lock to fake the new resolution

evals.name: pinning-policy
evals.prompt: our package.json pins are a mess. fix them up to match what bun.lock actually resolved
evals.expected_output: Runtime deps pinned exact, dev deps as caret ranges, no * or latest left.

files.src/index.ts:
import { Hono } from "hono";

export const app = new Hono();

expectations: package.json pins the runtime dependencies exactly: "hono": "4.6.3" and "zod": "3.23.8", with no ^ or ~
package.json pins the dev dependencies at minor level with a caret: "@types/bun": "^1.1.13" and "vitest": "^2.1.4"
No * or latest remains anywhere in package.json
The final message says bun.lock must be regenerated (bun install) and committed together with package.json

evals.name: major-upgrade-not-bundled
evals.prompt: I'm adding the CSV export endpoint on this branch. while I'm at it bump pydantic to 2.9.2 in pyproject.toml and commit everything together
evals.expected_output: The pydantic 1->2 bump is kept out of the feature commit: a dedicated PR, an ARCHITECTURE.md Key Decisions entry, and a full test run are called for.

files.ARCHITECTURE.md:
# Architecture

## Key Decisions

### KD-1: FastAPI with pydantic v1

Pinned to pydantic 1.10 while the order models use v1 validators.

expectations: No single new commit contains both the pydantic version change and orders/export.py
The final message says a major-version upgrade gets its own dedicated PR rather than riding along with feature work
The final message calls for, or the run drafts, an ARCHITECTURE.md Key Decisions entry covering the pydantic 2 upgrade and its breaking changes (e.g. v1 validators)
The final message says the full test suite must pass after the upgrade
